title: Provider-Agnostic AI Bridge Foundation (Phases 1, 2A, 2B, 2C-1, 2C-2)
goal: Implement the vendor-neutral foundation for the JESTER multi-agent AI Bridge, establishing clean separation of Role, Agent, Provider, and Model without vendor coupling.
constraints: Do not import vendor SDKs in core.
Do not hardcode gemini or chatgpt in task lifecycle.
Do not modify product application code.
Do not modify historical task records.
acceptance_criteria: Task Protocol v2 supports role and assigned_agent separation.
Agent is independent from provider implementation.
Model/runtime is not hardcoded into Bridge Core.
Capabilities can be declared and validated.
Provider-specific response structures do not leak into core.
Mock Provider A and Mock Provider B execute through the same core contract.
Swapping the assigned agent/provider does not require changing the task lifecycle.
No OpenAI/Gemini SDK dependency exists in Bridge Core.
No Anthropic/Ollama implementation is added in Phase 1.
New Phase 1, 2A, 2B, 2C-1, and 2C-2 bridge tests pass.
Architecture documentation explains how future providers can be added without rewriting the core.
First live controlled end-to-end multi-agent workflow executed and verified.
